name: io.github.notformal/adsbeast
title: ADS Beast
description: Ad account audits, analytics, leads and campaign changes that run only from an approved preview.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Clients that support OAuth sign in through the ADS Beast consent screen and need no header. Otherwise: Bearer followed by a scoped ADS Beast API key (absk_...), created by an admin under API Keys.

api_key.description: Scoped ADS Beast API key, starts with absk_.
